verdict.rationale: Keycloak's Server Administration Guide documents WebAuthn, including in the default browser flow, as a second factor, and as LoginLess WebAuthn. It also has a dedicated Passkeys section covering Conditional UI/autofill, Modal UI, and mediation, so the passkey half of the story is clearly first-class. The pack has no evidence of magic links or email OTP as sign-in methods, which is roughly half the story. Missing for 10: magic-link sign-in, email OTP sign-in, independent hands-on corroboration of passkey flows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer passkeys/WebAuthn and passwordless options like magic links or email OTP as first-class sign-in methods
